name: La Tuna Fire
summary: Burned about 7,200 acres of the Verdugo Mountains during a record heat wave, the largest fire by acreage in Los Angeles city history at the time. Evacuations reached Glendale, Burbank and Tujunga, and the 210 Freeway closed.
glendale_link: Glendale's northern hillside neighborhoods sit against the Verdugos.
